schema_version: v0 — skill-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: An adversarial pass on a design or conclusion, fired BEFORE the claim (before /sorted): better approach? prior art? hidden assumption? real collision? do we back up? Also runs on any settled artifact on a cadence.
why: Catches a bad design while changing it is still cheap — the first of the five feedback loops (challenge-at-intent, pre-cost). It is the intuition loop at high tempo on unsettled thinking; the later background device is the same mechanism at slow tempo on settled thinking, so the question corpus accumulates yield from the first pass onward (Telos 5, measured). Distinct from /sorted's inward check (which verifies coverage AT the claim) and the advisor (adversarial WHEN stuck): one pose, three placements.
invoke: /challenge  (on the design in hand, any time before /sorted; or on a named artifact on cadence)
state: v0 — first cast 2026-07-15. A resolver-occupied nexus; the role-replacement staircase applies.

nexus.note: SKILL.md carries the live question set; this is the charter-face record of it.
nexus.routes_back: revise the design / abandon (didn't survive the pass — a CP2 win)

input_contract.target: what is being challenged — a design, an artifact, a decision, identified so the pass can be grounded. The birth cadence fills this from the /intent packet; the settled-artifact cadence fills it from the artifact at hand.
input_contract.better_approach: is there a cleaner, simpler, or smaller way to reach the same intent? Named and evaluated, or the honest finding that you looked and this is it. Law 1 re-derivation check.
input_contract.prior_art: has this been solved already — earlier in Cairn, in the quarry, or in the field? Re-deriving the settled is a defect (Law 1). Cite it or say honestly you looked.
input_contract.hidden_assumption: what is this taking for granted that could be false? The load-bearing assumptions stated so they can be checked.
input_contract.real_collision: does this conflict with an existing intention/Law/decision — really (why of each side, exclusive-and-terminal), or a distinction to record?
input_contract.back_up: proceed, revise, or abandon — the disposition. Three values, no fourth. 'Proceed' after a real challenge is a finding worth having.
input_contract.exit: routed_forward (challenge pass hardened the design) or routed_out (the design didn't survive — a CP2 win, not a loss)
input_contract.bullets: what the pass caught or confirmed — {text, stratum} list

how_it_learns: By escapes: when something survives /challenge and later breaks, the adversarial pass gains that failure mode as a gate-record — a new challenge question. It learns the angles it missed. Endpoint into cc-learning-store; interim by-hand.
traces_to: Law 1 (don't re-derive the settled — prior-art question)
CP2 (a design that dies here is data)
owner: the skills charter gates writes; Akien ratifies changes (signature gate)

counted_by.what_it_counts: EXACT for the birth cadence, which is this skill's firing event (ticket challenge-fires-at-intent): every /intent firing carries the five answers or is refused, so the count of intent berths carrying a challenge block IS the count of challenge passes at birth. Measured 2026-08-04: 3 of 10 intent berths — and the split is clean by date. Zero of the seven before 2026-08-03T16:35, three of three after. That is the gate turning on, not a leak; the seven are pre-physics firings and cannot be retrofitted (Law 7 — a record of truth is permanent).
counted_by.what_it_does_NOT_count: the OTHER cadence in this charter — the deliberate pass over a settled artifact, in hand, no clock (CLAUDE.md's own challenges are the standing example). That firing leaves no packet anywhere and is genuinely dark. So this skill is PARTLY counted, and the split is named rather than averaged away.
counted_by.why_not_the_seam: OVERRIDDEN by ticket skills-migrate-one-blow: input_contract added 2026-09-05. Original CC reasoning: challenge fires INSIDE /intent, on the same packet, at the same moment. Its own door would mean two berths for one act and a second exit vocabulary for a step that has no exit of its own. It is counted through its host because it runs inside its host. THE OVERRIDE: the contract serves future external users ('better to have the device tell you up front that your data is invalid' — Akien, 2026-09-04), and the standalone cadence (settled-artifact challenge) was genuinely dark.

proof: skill node → done only when cairnmap recompiles green (derivation gate). IOU until cairnmap exists — tracked in proofs/.
provenance: converged in the founding design conversation (MAP.md 'Workflow + starting skills', 2026-07-15). Relation to the challenge GATE (the inward check /sorted fires) noted there: same pose, different placement.
learns: It does not; it fires the challenge protocol without learning from outcomes.
